name: skills
description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.
one_liner: A personal collection of ready-made instruction sets for AI coding assistants, written by an experienced engineer, that anyone can install to make their assistant work more like a seasoned developer.
buyer: A working developer already using an AI coding assistant who wants proven, battle-tested prompt setups instead of writing their own from scratch.
business_use_cases: A freelance developer installs the skills pack across client projects to get more consistent, professional-grade AI-generated code faster.
A dev tooling company licenses or adapts individual skills as built-in presets in their own AI coding product.
A course creator builds a paid 'level up your AI coding workflow' course teaching developers to write and use skills like these.

money_ideas.idea: Run a paid newsletter or course teaching developers how to write their own high-quality skills, using this repo as the reference example.
Offer paid consulting to companies wanting a custom skills library tailored to their internal codebase conventions.

steal_this: This weekend, fork it into an industry-specific variant (e.g. skills tuned for fintech compliance code or game dev) and sell it as a niche premium pack.
